response.sql:
WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.points) AS avg_constructor_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_constructor_wins
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
  country,
  avg_constructor_points,
  avg_constructor_wins,
  avg_constructor_wins - AVG(avg_constructor_wins) OVER () AS wins_above_or_below_country_average
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country;

assumptions.assumption: The comparison average gives each country's average wins equal weight, as implied by “the average of the country figures.”
